description: Find apps across the top charts we measure: filter by category, storefront, chart (Top Grossing, Top Free, Top Paid or Top iPad), rank range, first-seen date, name or publisher, and by monthly revenue, monthly downloads or 30-day growth. Pass `estimates: true` to get each row's monthly revenue and downloads from Hive, one figure each, with the day of the figure. When a revenue, download or growth filter is set, apps Hive has no figure for yet are left out and counted in `noEstimate`. 20 credits for the list; with figures, or with a revenue, download or growth filter, 50 more per row returned. The answer carries `coverage`, the day the first-seen index opens, so every date you read is a day we indexed.

country.description: up to 5 storefront codes, comma separated, e.g. us,gb

estimates.description: true adds monthly revenue and downloads to every row (50 credits per row)

genre.description: up to 3 Apple genre ids, comma separated, e.g. 6007,6012

growthMax.description: 30-day change at most this, in percent

growthMin.description: 30-day change at least this, in percent (e.g. 20)

kind.description: grossing, free, paid or ipad (which chart the app is on)

limit.description: rows per page, 50 by default, up to 200

rankMax.description: best chart rank at most this

rankMin.description: best chart rank at least this

released.description: first seen within the last N months

revenueMax.description: monthly gross revenue at most this (USD)

revenueMin.description: monthly gross revenue at least this (USD)

text.description: match on app name or publisher name

name: find_apps
